_comment_family: The other cut of the same family, and the reason both packs declare a
full name instead of 'Proxima Nova': the two files share name ID 16,
so the family alone names neither of them. See the note in
proxima-nova-black.json, which this pack is the other half of - it is
also where the third spelling, the 'Proxima Nova Rg' this file writes
into name ID 1, is explained and refused.
Weight 700, which is the file's own usWeightClass and what the cut is
700 against the Black's 900 is a narrower gap than the pack this
design was cut from works with, and that is a fact about the channels
rather than about these files - beauty-hacks states it where it picks
the two, with the measurements, and every channel cut to that design
since names it there rather than restating it.
_comment_css: Not declared in styles.css: this face arrived with a channel and is
registered from this JSON at load time (see registerFace in
js/channels.js), which is the route content/README.md describes.
Nothing has to be added to the stylesheet for it.
_comment_local: What the machine may already know the face by, tried after the file,
and used by the installer as the name it registers this face under
The PostScript name first, then the Windows full name. Both name this
one cut rather than the family or the four-style group it was filed
in, so a machine answering to either is answering with this file.
_comment_stack: The lighter half of the pair proxima-nova-black.json describes, and
written against it: that stack falls to Arial Black and this one
falls to Segoe UI Semibold, so a machine missing both files still
draws the two cuts at two weights rather than at one. Which of them
is the block and which is the picked word is the channel's, and every
channel carrying the pair answers it the same way: this cut is the
block and the Black is what a picked word climbs to. The fallback
pair does not have to know, because what it preserves is the gap.
Arial Black and Impact are therefore absent on purpose, which is the
opposite of what a bold grotesque would normally fall through. Either
of them behind this face would land it in the same register as the
other cut's own fallback and take the difference between them away -
and on a channel whose highlight IS the difference in weight, that is
the whole of the highlight gone.
stack: 'Proxima Nova Bold', 'Segoe UI Semibold', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif
